decision: Use v16 alone as default development detector. For reverse-occlusion demo proximity, run v16 + demo adaptation supplement so established boxes survive and missing proposals are filled.
solo_adaptation_rejected_because: Demo-adapted best/last alone improved reverse 8/8 tracking but increased fixed-set forklift FN (2→5).
ppe_demo_candidate_status: experimental_not_promoted; helmet recall regressed when used alone
